nick_oilpress_desc: A heavy barrel for steeping and maturing the bases of weapon oils.
nick_weaponoils_replaced_hands: {0} replaces the oil on your hands
nick_weaponoils_hands_worn_off: The oil on your hands has worn off
nick_weaponoils_worn_off: The oil on your {0} has worn off
nick_weaponoils_not_melee: Oil can only be applied to a melee weapon you are holding, or your bare hands
nick_oilbase_desc: An oil base, cooked at the cauldron. Matures in an oil press into finished oil.
nick_oil_ember_desc: Resin and honey, cooked slow. Sets a blade smouldering with fire damage.
nick_oil_keen_desc: Flint grit steeped in resin. A sharper bite for any blade.
nick_oil_trollfat_desc: Rendered troll fat. Swings cost less stamina.
nick_oil_barkhide_desc: Pine bark and core wood steeped to a tar. The weapon wears slower, and an axe or pickaxe bites deeper into wood and stone.
nick_oil_venom_desc: Swamp ooze, thick and foul. Adds poison damage.
nick_oil_leech_desc: Boiled bloodbags. Drinks a little of what it cuts: part of the damage you deal comes back as health.
nick_oil_rime_desc: Freezing glands and crystal. The edge bites with frost damage and chills what it strikes.
nick_oil_storm_desc: Needle venom and tar. The blade crackles with lightning damage.
nick_oil_loxfat_desc: Lox fat and tar, heavy and sticky. Every blow staggers harder.
nick_oil_wisp_desc: Wisp light and sap. The edge passes through any hide: added damage that no armour or resistance turns aside.
nick_oil_royal_desc: Royal jelly and sap. Steadies your guard: whatever you block with, shield or blade, blocks with more power.
nick_oil_cinder_desc: Molten core, sulfur and charred bone. The blade glows like a coal: fierce fire damage, and spirit damage that burns the dead.
